## YGM / ygm-bench dftracer Pipeline — Reproduction Package

This folder is a **self-contained deliverable**: everything needed to reproduce
the ygm/20260804_221748 session's build, annotation, and final validated
128-rank scaled run lives here — no session workspace, no conversation
history required.

### 1. Copy this folder and set your workspace root

```bash
cp -r final_report/ /your/scratch/ygm_repro/
cd /your/scratch/ygm_repro/
```

Edit `config.ini` and set `WORKSPACE_ROOT=/your/scratch/ygm_repro` (or wherever
you copied this folder to). This is the ONLY file with a real path in it —
every script under `scripts/` sources `scripts/lib_load_config.sh`, which reads
`config.ini`, instead of hardcoding a path.

### 2. Install dependencies and build

```bash
bash scripts/install.sh
```

This rebuilds dftracer from source (GNU MPICH wrapper, matching YGM's own
`PrgEnv-gnu` toolchain — see `patches/` and `REPORT.md` section 3 for why GNU,
not the default Cray-clang) and builds the annotated YGM (`MPI_test_comm`) and
`ygm-bench` (`around_the_world_ygm`) against it.

### 3. Run every script this session actually used, in order

```bash
bash scripts/run_all.sh <flux-alloc-id>
```

This drives, in order: the dftracer source install, the annotated-YGM build,
the ygm-bench build, the single-process smoke test, and the final scaled
validation run (`scripts/run_scaled_ygm_bench.sh`) — 4 nodes x 32 ranks/node,
`around_the_world_ygm -n 5600 -t 1 -p`, with full annotation + DFTRACER
SELECTIVE aggregation enabled. You need a Flux allocation on the same system
class (Tuolumne, Cray PE) — request one with e.g.
`flux alloc --bg -N 4 -q pdebug -t 60m` and pass its allocation id to
`run_all.sh`.

Each script under `scripts/` does one job:
- `install_dftracer_src_gnu.sh` — from-source dftracer build, GNU MPICH ABI-matched (used by `install.sh` step 1/3)
- `build_gnu_src_final.sh` — builds annotated YGM (`MPI_test_comm`) (used by `install.sh` step 2/3)
- `build_ygm_bench_final.sh` — builds `ygm-bench` against the annotated tree (used by `install.sh` step 3/3)
- `install.sh` — chains the three build steps above into one command
- `run_dftracer_run_ygm_bench.sh` — early 1-node probe: `around_the_world_ygm -n 50 -t 2 -p` + `barrier_bench -b 500 -a 0 -t 2 -p` (superseded by the final scaled run, kept for provenance)
- `run_probe_wrapper.sh` — an intermediate diagnostic wrapper used during the scale bisection (rank-density/OOM investigation)
- `run_dftracer_run_ygm_bench_v2.sh` — a second-iteration 1-node probe (post buffer-size env var fix)
- `run_dftracer_run_ygm_bench_4n.sh` — an intermediate 4-node scale probe, before the hot-loop/aggregation fix
- `run_scaled_ygm_bench.sh` — **the final validated 4-node/128-rank scaled run** (`around_the_world_ygm -n 5600 -t 1 -p`, full annotation + DFTRACER selective aggregation) — this is the run REPORT.md's headline numbers come from
- `run_all.sh` — runs all of the above, in order, against a Flux allocation
- `render_pdf.sh` — regenerates `REPORT.pdf` from `REPORT.md` standalone (no MCP tool needed)
- `readme_smoke_test.sh` — static check that this README names every script and a runnable command (re-run after editing this file)

### 4. How to tell it worked

Compare your reproduced run against `REPORT.md` section 1 (Executive Summary)
and section 2 (Baseline Detail): the final scaled run should complete in
roughly 600-720s (single-run reference: 660.04s / 11.0 min — no replicate
range is available, so treat +/-10% as "in the same ballpark", not a strict
noise band) and produce ~128 rank trace files totaling on the order of tens
of MB (reference: 55MB) under a fresh `traces_repro_<timestamp>/` directory.
If the run instead produces gigabyte-scale per-rank trace files, the
selective-aggregation env vars did not take effect — check
`DFTRACER_ENABLE_AGGREGATION`/`DFTRACER_AGGREGATION_TYPE`/`DFTRACER_AGGREGATION_FILE`
are set exactly as in `run_scaled_ygm_bench.sh`.

See `REPORT.md` sections 6-8 for the full optimization ledger and comparator
table this reproduction is meant to validate.
